title: Beyond the gotcha game: Moving from AI detection to verification-first supports stronger academic integrity
summary_en: AI, as they say, has entered the chat. The benefits of AI, when applied responsibly, can be a boon to the college and university environment, supporting instruction, study methods, accessibility, course design, administrative tasks and much more.
title_cn: Beyond the gotcha game: Moving from AI detection to verification-first supports stronger academic integrity
